before: Opening a document reads its package on the page's thread, from its bytes.
after: A document parsed ahead of its open (parseDocument, typically on a worker) opens from that read, which is the same read of the same bytes under the same limits, so the session, its package and its save are unchanged.
reason: Only where the package read runs changes. The opened session is the session the bytes open, and nothing about it enters shared state, operations, snapshots or protocol messages.
